name: Application Threat Model
description: Document the full application threat model including actors, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, mitigations, and residual risks for the Tribunus desktop application.
purpose: Establish a comprehensive threat model that identifies security actors, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and planned mitigations to guide all subsequent security work and provide a baseline for residual risk acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Threat model document covers all identified actors (user, extensions, network, local processes, OS)
Attack surfaces are enumerated and mapped to trust boundaries
Each identified threat has a corresponding mitigation or explicit residual risk acceptance
Model is reviewed and signed off by security engineering
Document is stored in the repository as a living artifact
